newsitem.title: USA: TWA cuts fares on summer travel.
newsitem.headline: TWA cuts fares on summer travel.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Thursday that it is initiating a summer sale on air travel that will offer flyers domestic discounts as much as 65 percent below standard 21-day advance purchase prices.
The company also said it is cutting some prices on trans-Atlantic flights by as much as per $350 round-trip in July and August.
The airline said its prices on certain domestic routes will also be lower than those of AMR Corp, UAL Corp or Delta Air Lines Inc in earlier sales.
Tickets must be purchased, said the airline, before May 30, and are good for travel through October 8.
Certain restrictions apply to receive the lowest fares.
